name: Signature Verification Tests
description: Write comprehensive test suite for HMAC-SHA256 signature verification. Tests must include: valid signature acceptance, invalid signature rejection, missing signature handling, timing-safe comparison, empty body handling, and different content types.

name: Idempotency Handler Tests
description: Write test suite for idempotency handling. Tests must include: first request acceptance, duplicate request rejection, cache expiration, and isolation between different idempotency keys.

name: Webhook Integration Tests
description: Write end-to-end integration tests for webhook endpoint with verification. Tests must include: valid webhook processing, invalid signature rejection, security event logging, and idempotency correctness.

name: HMAC Signature Utility
description: Implement HMAC-SHA256 signature calculation and timing-safe comparison using Node.js crypto module. Must use timingSafeEqual to prevent timing attacks.

name: Verification Middleware
description: Implement webhook signature verification middleware. Extract Toss-Signature header, calculate expected signature, compare using timing-safe function, and return verification result.

name: Idempotency Handler
description: Implement in-memory idempotency handler with TTL. Store processed request IDs, check for duplicates, implement cache expiration, and provide upgrade path to Redis for production.

name: Security Logger
description: Implement structured security logging for webhook events. Log success and failure events with metadata including timestamp, request ID, IP address, and failure reason. Never log sensitive data.

name: Update Webhook Route
description: Integrate verification middleware, idempotency handler, and security logger into existing webhook route. Add signature verification before processing, handle verification failures with appropriate HTTP status codes, and ensure comprehensive error handling.

name: Extract Constants
description: Extract magic strings and numbers to named constants. Create constants file if needed. Improve code maintainability.

name: Add JSDoc Comments
description: Add comprehensive JSDoc comments to all public functions and classes. Document parameters, return values, exceptions, and usage examples.

name: Optimize Performance
description: Optimize signature verification performance to ensure < 100ms processing time. Profile code, identify bottlenecks, and implement optimizations while maintaining security.

name: Improve Error Messages
description: Enhance error messages for better debugging and user experience. Provide clear, actionable error messages without exposing sensitive information.

name: Strengthen TypeScript Types
description: Add strict TypeScript types for all functions and interfaces. Eliminate 'any' types, add proper return types, and ensure type safety.
